title: Reply: pleasure is the conscious effect of a reward system, which is selected

statements.text: Neural events in sensory systems cause feelings, and neural events in a reward system cause the continuance or avoidance of behavior. Pleasure is the effect in consciousness of the reward events. Both kinds of neural event have behavioral effects and can be selected, so the alignment of pleasure with useful stimuli follows from the alignment of the two neural systems, which is independently plausible.
